name: Macfos Ltd
title: Macfos Ltd - 543787 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Macfos (Robu.in), an online electronics distributor, reports FY26 revenue of about INR312 cr, up ~67% like-for-like, with no capacity or capex signal; debt funds inventory and margin is the key watch item.

triggers.label: Slow-moving inventory 2.5 → 6 (analyst figure)
triggers.quote: slowdown of inventory that has increased from 2.5 to 6 something

triggers.label: Working capital days up ~20 vs last year
triggers.quote: the increase in working capital days compared to end of last year, there's some 20-odd day increase

triggers.label: Annual unique customers 1.45 lakh → 1.85 lakh
triggers.quote: Annual jo hai that is 1.85 lakh roughly jo last year 1.45 lakh tha wo 1.85 lakh ho gaya hai

guidance.quote: that is what we are targeting, ki hamare jo regular margins hain, usse 10% extra margin hum ROBU 2.0 wale products se kamaaye

red_flags.label: Debt-funded inventory growth
red_flags.quote: we are never worried about the debt for company because hum jo bhi debt lete hain most of it or almost saara debt we convert it into inventory

red_flags.label: Slow-moving / dead inventory rising, due to new component category
red_flags.quote: wo inventory badhegi, dead inventory usse badhegi

red_flags.label: Working-capital days up ~20 days; no explanation given
red_flags.quote: As of now, I don't have the relevant data on hand to explain this

red_flags.label: Traffic data methodology changed; restated visitor figures
red_flags.quote: we have changed the methodology and downloaded data from first quarter to last quarter

red_flags.label: Segment revenue split withheld
red_flags.quote: we have stopped giving the breakup of the revenue b ecause of the competition thing

evasions.quote: As of now, I don't have the relevant data on hand to explain this.

evasions.topic: Q4 unique customers and visitor data
evasions.quote: I don't think I have that number on hand for Quarter 4.
So we are not giving any revenue numbers as of now for ROBU 2.0
Wo number kuch bhi ho, doesn't matter.
